purpose: Held-out paraphrase set to measure TRUE KPI-matcher precision. Each question is phrased naturally and deliberately avoids the KPI's name and alias phrases, so it is not the example the matcher is tuned on. Misses are expected and informative (they show where lexical matching breaks).
how_to_use: This is a measurement report, not a hard pass/fail gate.
